name: @vigilia/editor
description: Desktop authoring experience. Adds interaction overlays and inspectors on top of the shared renderer.
//: The editor adds interaction and inspectors over @vigilia/renderer-core, and is migrating its rendering and interaction onto Fabric — see spec 0013. Fabric IS an expected dependency here now; the 2026-09 prohibition is reversed, because Fabric renders the player too and §31's one-renderer rule is satisfied rather than waived. Import from 'fabric/es', never bare 'fabric': the default entry is one pre-bundled file no tree-shaker can see into and costs 45 KB gzip more for identical imports. Still no UI framework: one is worth adding when the inspector surface is real enough to judge the trade.
